name: Overwhelming Momentum
desc: Each consecutive hit within 2s grants 3% more damage, up to 20 stacks. Stacks are lost when you stop attacking. You deal 10% less damage with your first hit.

name: Bulwark Mastery
desc: Blocking a hit grants 15% damage reduction for 2 seconds

name: Fortress of Flesh
desc: While stationary for 1 second, gain 30% damage reduction. 15% reduced movement speed.

name: Perfect Aim
desc: Projectile hits against enemies further than 180 units deal 30% more damage. Hits against enemies closer than 100 units deal 30% less damage. +50% increased critical chance.

name: Automaton Doctrine
desc: Turrets deal 70% more damage. You can have 1 fewer turret (minimum 1).

name: Elemental Convergence
desc: Hitting a chilled or shocked enemy with fire, or a burning enemy with ice or lightning, deals 35% more damage. 10% less damage against enemies with no status ailment.

name: One Mind
desc: Minions deal 60% more damage and have 30% more life. Your own spells and attacks deal 30% less damage.

name: Blood for Power
desc: Skills cost Life instead of Mana. 15% increased damage. You have no mana regeneration.

name: Glass Cannon
desc: You deal 40% more damage. You have 40% less maximum life.

name: Blood Drinker
desc: 2% of hit damage you deal is leeched as life.

name: Crimson Dance
desc: Your bleeds deal 60% more damage and last 50% longer. Your hits deal 10% less damage.

name: Prismatic Soul
desc: +25% fire, cold and lightning resistance and 15% more elemental damage, but 40% less armour and evasion.

name: Wind Dancer
desc: Dodge rolling grants Wind Dance for 3 seconds: 40% more damage and 15% increased movement speed. Without Wind Dance your hits deal 10% less damage.

name: Executioner's Creed
desc: Hits against enemies below 35% life are always critical strikes. -30% critical strike multiplier.

name: Mind over Matter
desc: 30% of damage taken is removed from your mana before your life.

name: Void Pact
desc: Hits against enemies suffering any ailment deal 25% more damage. 30% increased ailment duration. 10% less maximum life.
